authority: D-103: test a more reachable single golden Privateer economy
question: Can golden Privateer with ordinary Brann/Rogers/Escapee earn a full-suffix benefit? Ordinary complete economy improves surviving growth but worsens rank; double-golden economy improves both. Privateer is Pirate-targetable, unlike neutral Brann.
budget: 196 CPU suffixes, same 49 sources and two futures, no new learning
selection: All fixed development sources; no win/loss filtering
limitations: Initial single golden component is endowed, not naturally acquired
No claim that golden Privateer purchase is always correct
